G3588: the (sometimes to be supplied, at others omitted, in English idiom)
G2250: day, i.e. (literally) the time space between dawn and dark, or the whole 24 hours (but several days were usually reckoned by the Jews as inclusive of the parts of both extremes); figuratively, a period (always defined more or less clearly by the context)
G3778: the he (she or it), i.e. this or that (often with article repeated)

G4314: a preposition of direction; forward to, i.e. toward (with the genitive case, the side of, i.e. pertaining to; with the dative case, by the side of, i.e. near to; usually with the accusative case, the place, time, occasion, or respect, which is the destination of the relation, i.e. whither or for which it is predicated)
G1248: attendance (as a servant, etc.); figuratively (eleemosynary) aid, (official) service (especially of the Christian teacher, or technically of the diaconate)
G5503: a widow (as lacking a husband), literally or figuratively
G846: the reflexive pronoun self, used (alone or in the comparative ) of the third person , and (with the proper personal pronoun) of the other persons
G4341: to call toward oneself, i.e. summon, invite
G1427: two and ten, i.e. a dozen
G4128: a fulness, i.e. a large number, throng, populace

G3756: the absolute negative (compare ) adverb; no or not
G2641: to leave down, i.e. behind; by implication, to abandon, have remaining

G2316: figuratively, a magistrate; by Hebraism, very
G1247: to be an attendant, i.e. wait upon (menially or as a host, friend, or (figuratively) teacher); technically, to act as a Christian deacon
G5132: a table or stool (as being four-legged), usually for food (figuratively, a meal); also a counter for money (figuratively, a broker's office for loans at interest)
G1980: to inspect, i.e. (by implication) to select; by extension, to go to see, relieve
G80: a brother (literally or figuratively) near or remote (much like )
G435: a man (properly as an individual male)
G1537: literal or figurative; direct or remote)
G3140: to be a witness, i.e. testify (literally or figuratively)
G4134: replete, or covered over; by analogy, complete
G4151: a current of air, i.e. breath (blast) or a breeze; by analogy or figuratively, a spirit, i.e. (human) the rational soul, (by implication) vital principle, mental disposition, etc., or (superhuman) an angel, demon, or (divine) God, Christ's spirit, the Holy Spirit
G40: sacred (physically, pure, morally blameless or religious, ceremonially, consecrated)
G2532: and, also, even, so then, too, etc.; often used in connection (or composition) with other particles or small words
G4678: wisdom (higher or lower, worldly or spiritual)
G3739: the relatively (sometimes demonstrative) pronoun, who, which, what, that
G2525: to place down (permanently), i.e. (figuratively) to designate, constitute, convoy
G1909: properly, meaning superimposition (of time, place, order, etc.), as a relation of distribution (with the genitive case), i.e. over, upon, etc.; of rest (with the dative case) at, on, etc.; of direction (with the accusative case) towards, upon, etc.
G5532: employment, i.e. an affair; also (by implication) occasion, demand, requirement or destitution
G4342: to be earnest towards, i.e. (to a thing) to persevere, be constantly diligent, or (in a place) to attend assiduously all the exercises, or (to a person) to adhere closely to (as a servitor)
G700: to be agreeable (or by implication, to seek to be so)
G1799: in the face of (literally or figuratively)

G4402: before the dance; Prochorus, a Christian
G3532: victorious over the people; Nicolaus, a heretic
G4339: an arriver from a foreign region, i.e. (specially), an acceder (convert) to Judaism ("proselyte")
G491: an Antiochian or inhabitant of Antiochia
G2476: to stand (transitively or intransitively), used in various applications (literally or figuratively)
G652: a delegate; specially, an ambassador of the Gospel; officially a commissioner of Christ ("apostle") (with miraculous powers)
G4336: to pray to God, i.e. supplicate, worship
G2007: to impose (in a friendly or hostile sense)
G5495: the hand (literally or figuratively (power); especially (by Hebraism) a means or instrument)
G837: to grow ("wax"), i.e. enlarge (literal or figurative, active or passive)
G2419: Hierusalem (i.e. Jerushalem), the capitol of Palestine
G4970: of uncertain derivation) as adverb; vehemently, i.e. in a high degree, much

G5037: both or also (properly, as correlation of )
G3793: a throng (as borne along); by implication, the rabble; by extension, a class of people; figuratively, a riot

G3173: big (literally or figuratively, in a very wide application)
G2992: a people (in general; thus differing from , which denotes one's own populace)
G450: to stand up (literal or figurative, transitive or intransitive)
G5100: some or any person or object
G4864: an assemblage of persons; specially, a Jewish "synagogue" (the meeting or the place); by analogy, a Christian church
G2956: i.e. Cyrenæan, i.e. inhabitant of Cyrene
G221: an Alexandreian or inhabitant of Alexandria
G575: "off," i.e. away (from something near), in various senses (of place, time, or relation; literal or figurative)
G2791: Cilicia, a region of Asia Minor
G773: Asia, i.e. Asia Minor, or (usually) only its western shore
G4802: to investigate jointly, i.e. discuss, controvert, cavil
G2480: to have (or exercise) force (literally or figuratively)
G5119: the when, i.e. at the time that (of the past or future, also in consecution)

G1519: to or into (indicating the point reached or entered), of place, time, or (figuratively) purpose (result, etc.); also in adverbial phrases

G4787: to move together, i.e. (specially), to excite as a mass (to sedition)
G4245: older; as noun, a senior; specially, an Israelite Sanhedrist (also figuratively, member of the celestial council) or Christian "presbyter"
G2186: to stand upon, i.e. be present (in various applications, friendly or otherwise, usually literal);
G71: properly, to lead; by implication, to bring, drive, (reflexively) go, (specially) pass (time), or (figuratively) induce
G4892: a joint session, i.e. (specially), the Jewish Sanhedrin; by analogy, a subordinate tribunal
G3144: a witness (literally (judicially) or figuratively (genitive case)); by analogy, a "martyr"
G444: from ); man-faced, i.e. a human being

G2596: (prepositionally) down (in place or time), in varied relations (according to the case (genitive, dative or accusative) with which it is joined)
G5117: a spot (general in space, but limited by occupancy; whereas is a large but participle locality), i.e. location (as a position, home, tract, etc.); figuratively, condition, opportunity; specially, a scabbard
G3551: law (through the idea of prescriptive usage), genitive case (regulation), specially, (of Moses (including the volume); also of the Gospel), or figuratively (a principle)
G1063: properly, assigning a reason (used in argument, explanation or intensification; often with other particles)
G2424: Jesus (i.e. Jehoshua), the name of our Lord and two (three) other Israelites
G3480: a Nazoræan, i.e. inhabitant of Nazareth; by extension, a Christian
G2647: to loosen down (disintegrate), i.e. (by implication) to demolish (literally or figuratively); specially (compare ) to halt for the night
G1485: a usage (prescribed by habit or law)
G3860: to surrender, i.e yield up, intrust, transmit
G3708: by extension, to attend to; by Hebraism, to experience; passively, to appear
G4383: the front (as being towards view), i.e. the countenance, aspect, appearance, surface; by implication, presence, person
G32: compare ) (to bring tidings); a messenger; especially an "angel"; by implication, a pastor
